title: HRM winter operations: historical costs and report samples
publisher: Office of the Auditor General, Halifax Regional Municipality

auditScope.summary: Management of road and sidewalk snow/ice clearing operations and contracts. Municipal-facility clearing, procurement and assessment of the standards themselves were outside scope.

scope: Two historical year summaries and five contractor-report sample categories from the June 2025 audit. These are different record types, not seven contracts or a complete spending ledger.
recordUnit: historical year summary or contractor-report sample category

records.eventAttribution: Public Works weather event calendars, as reported by the Auditor General
records.costAttribution: HRM SAP, as reported by the Auditor General

costContext.summary: The auditor reports that staff salaries and fleet equipment were excluded from centrally captured in-house costs. The published table leaves both in-house totals unknown.

sampleContext.summary: Three contract zones were sampled per date; all contracts were covered across testing. Expected counts differ with each sampled contract reporting requirement. These are counts of documents obtained, not measured snow-clearing outcomes.

managementContext.summary: Management planned a policy defining performance data, collection processes and indicators.
Management planned to revise required reports and centrally track reporting compliance.

limits: Historical source facts only. Report month, letter date, audit period and retrieval/review dates are different. The precise observation date for the report samples is not established, and current service conditions are not verified.
The two fiscal-year labels are retained as printed, without invented start/end dates. The audit window spans November 2022 to April 2024 and is not a replacement for those labels.

Contractor amounts are source-reported financial costs rounded to one decimal million, not exact cash payments, invoice totals, budgets or complete program costs. The source dollar symbol is preserved; an explicit currency code and cash/accrual basis are not established.
In-house costs are explicitly Unknown, never zero. No in-house-versus-contractor efficiency comparison, total program cost, per-event calculation, cross-year sum, trend or loss is established.
Each report category has its own applicable-contract scope and expected-count denominator. No sum, overall compliance rate, vendor ranking or whole-population extrapolation is accepted.

Document receipt does not establish report quality, clearing performance, safety, service-standard compliance, amounts owed, financial loss or personal wrongdoing. No individual contractor identity is assigned to these sample results.
Management responses are attributed plans, not evidence of implementation or current recommendation completion. No join is made to other audit-follow-up collections.

sourceRights.projection: Numerical facts, short source identifiers and brief original paraphrases with attribution only. No PDF, page images, recommendation prose, signatures or contacts are republished.
